items.structure_p1: 第一段用過去式交代前三格漫畫的內容：男子在麵店吃麵、小孩在一旁寫功課；男子吃完離開後，老闆和小孩發現他留下一袋錢。把場景、人物、動作講清楚就好，不用先寫結局。
items.structure_p2: 第二段接著想像第四格：男子在車站才發現錢不見了，接下來他怎麼做、老闆和小孩怎麼處理這袋錢，寫出一個有結局、有轉折的故事收尾，最後一句點出誠實或將心比心的意義。
ideas: 男子在車站翻遍口袋才驚覺錢不見，立刻搭車趕回麵店
老闆和小孩發現錢包後，決定在店門口等失主回來，而不是自己留下
小孩提議如果沒人來認領就送去警察局招領
男子趕回麵店，看到老闆手上還拿著那袋錢，鬆了一口氣並道謝
男子事後多留一筆小費給誠實的小孩，故事收在「誠實有好報」
grammar: 四格漫畫是連續事件，全篇用過去簡單式敘述，動詞時態要前後一致。
可以用「Upon Ving, S V」寫『一…就…』的瞬間，例如發現錢不見的那一刻。
分詞構句能把兩個動作壓成一句，例如 Grateful for the boy's honesty, the man thanked him again and again。
小心 it 沒有指涉對象：要說『他的錢』就寫 his money／the bag，不要只寫 it 卻沒有先講過。

from_bank.sentence: The moment I saw the chart, I realized my own habits were very different.
from_bank.why: 「The moment S 過去式, S 過去式」正好可以用來寫男子在車站『那一刻』發現錢不見的關鍵轉折，把 chart 換成 he reached into his pocket 就能套用。

from_bank.sentence: Upon entering the workplace, I would start setting aside a fixed portion of my salary.
from_bank.why: Upon Ving, S V 是『一…就…』的句型，可以改寫成 Upon opening the bag, the owner and the boy were astonished to see so much cash，讓第一段的動作更緊湊。

from_bank.sentence: No sooner had I received my first salary than I started planning how to divide it.
from_bank.why: No sooner had S Vpp than S Ved 語氣最強，很適合放大男子發現錢不見那一刻的驚慌感。

from_bank.sentence: Comparing my plan with the average, I found a clear gap.
from_bank.why: Ving 開頭的分詞構句可以改成 Searching through his pockets, he found nothing but a train ticket，畫面感比一般句子強。

common_mistakes: Compared with regular work days, it's third the amount of people coming to participate the game. → On holidays, the game attracts three times the number of spectators it does on regular work days.（只要打出 it／it's，先停下來問一次「it 是誰？」句子裡找不到，就換成一個真正的名詞）
倒裝／助動詞後面：did he won → did he win（動詞回原形）
a child who grow up → who grew up（時態要跟主詞的時間一致）
living（活著）／leaving（離開）搞混
items.model_essay: While a man was enjoying a bowl of noodles, a young boy sat nearby, quietly doing his homework. After the man finished eating and walked away, the boy noticed a heavy bag left behind on the bench and quickly called the owner over. Upon opening it, they were both astonished to find it stuffed with cash, so they decided to wait by the door for the owner to return. Meanwhile, the man had already reached the train station. The moment he reached into his pocket, he realized his money was gone, and his heart sank. Without hesitation, he rushed all the way back to the noodle shop. To his relief, the owner was still waiting there, the bag safely in hand. Grateful beyond words, the man thanked the honest boy again and again, insisting that he keep some cash as a reward for doing the right thing.
model_essay_used: Upon Ving, S V（改寫自 Upon opening it, they were astonished...）
The moment S 過去式, S 過去式（The moment he reached into his pocket...）
分詞構句 Vpp 開頭（Grateful beyond words, the man thanked...）

items.structure_p1: 第一段是信的開頭與關心：稱呼朋友、說明你注意到他最近沉迷電玩、常熬夜，因此荒廢課業還被父母罵，表達你的擔心，語氣要像朋友不是說教。

ideas: 設定每天固定的遊戲時間，例如寫完作業後才能玩一小時

phrases.en: set a time limit on N

grammar: 書信要有明確的稱呼（Dear ...,）和署名（結尾 Yours, / Your friend,），語氣是朋友式的勸告，不要太說教。

from_bank.sentence: The temptation of online shopping coerces me into turning away from saving.
from_bank.why: coerce sb into Ving 這個句型可以改寫成 The temptation of video games coerces you into staying up all night，很貼切地寫出電玩對朋友的拉力。

from_bank.sentence: I would stand apart from the crowd as having a short period of break is more aligned with my needs.

from_bank.sentence: Reluctant though I was to cut my entertainment budget, I did it anyway.
from_bank.why: adj. though S V 的讓步倒裝句型可以改成 Reluctant as you may be to give up gaming at night, a small change now will make a big difference，語氣比 Although 更有變化。

from_bank.sentence: After all, there is no single correct answer; what matters is finding the arrangement that fits one's own life.
from_bank.why: 這句收尾的邏輯『重點是找到適合自己的安排』可以直接借來鼓勵朋友：找到一個能兼顧電玩和課業的安排，比完全戒掉更實際。

common_mistakes: Compared with regular work days, it's third the amount of people coming to participate the game. → On holidays, the game attracts three times the number of spectators it does on regular work days.（只要打出 it／it's，先停下來問一次「it 是誰？」句子裡找不到，就換成一個真正的名詞）
固定搭配：associate to → associate A with B；participate the game → participate in the game；coerce me to turn away → coerce me into turning away
冠詞漏掉：In comparison with average Taiwanese adult → with the average Taiwanese adult；willing to allocate majority of salary → the majority of my salary
用語不精準：my income management may seem quite bizarre → unconventional（bizarre 語氣太重）；people coming to participate in the game → spectators（一個字取代一串修飾語，是拉分最快的方法）
items.model_essay: Dear Alex, I have noticed that you have been staying up late playing video games almost every night, and your grades have started to slip. I know your parents have scolded you about it, and honestly, I am a little worried too. Although gaming can be a great way to relax, letting it take over your whole schedule will only hurt you in the long run. Why not set a fixed time limit, like one hour after finishing your homework? You could also ask your parents to keep your console overnight so you are not tempted to play until dawn. If you want, we could study together after school and keep each other on track. It will not be easy at first, but a small change now can turn things around before it is too late. Your friend, Ming
model_essay_used: 讓步句 Although S V, S V（Although gaming can be a great way to relax...）
coerce sb into Ving 概念改寫（temptation...take over 的拉力寫法）
收尾 what matters/turn things around 精神（a small change now can turn things around...）

Just as the bus turned a sharp corner and the woman lost her balance for a second, the student finally stood up without another thought and gestured for her to sit down. Grateful, the woman nodded and thanked him warmly, and the tension in the cabin melted into quiet smiles. One by one, the others put down their phones too, drawn into the conversation. Laughter slowly filled the room again, replacing the silence. Reluctant though some of them were to leave their group chats, they realized that the stories shared at that table meant far more than anything on their screens.
